title: Binomial tail recursion
statement: For a relation $r$ on $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$ and a natural number $D$, define $B_D(m,j)$ recursively by $B_D(m,0)=0$, $B_D(0,j+1)=1$, and $B_D(m+1,j+1)=B_D(m,j)/D+(1-1/D)B_D(m,j+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A relation on Fin n with decidable membership
